privacyDescription: The notice published at /privacy-policy/, in every language the site serves.
toastSaveFirst: Save your changes first — a run reads the saved text.
toastSaved: Saved. The site picks it up within a few minutes.
titleHint: The h1 on the page and the first half of its browser tab title.
searchHint: Left empty, the page falls back to its own title and first paragraph.
metaTitleHint: Around 60 characters — Google cuts it there.
effectiveHint: Shown under the title. Not the same as the last edit — fixing a typo does not move it.
